_note: Hand-kept log. Every entry was read off a primary source and, where a market reaction is claimed, measured against exchange data. Add new ones at the top. Do not paste in anything unverified — the whole point of this page is that it is checkable.

events.title: Fed hikes to 4%, first increase since July 2023
events.detail: Warsh's first decision as chair, delivered unanimously, with 4.00–4.25% projected through 2027.
events.impact: Decision hour ranged 1.97% on BTCUSDT against a 0.39% median over the prior 1,000 hours — top 1.3% of the sample — and closed −0.18%. Six hours later price was +0.10% from the decision open.

events.title: Warsh: no need to harm the labour market
events.detail: "I don't believe that we need to do harm to the labor markets to achieve our objective."
events.impact: No chair has ever said the opposite, so the line carries no policy information on its own.

events.title: Dollar clears 156 yen, BOJ decides Friday
events.detail: US at 3.75–4% against Japan's 1% puts the policy gap near 300bp. Reuters has 97% of economists expecting a hike to 1.25%, which would be Japan's highest in 31 years.
events.impact: The August 2024 carry unwind needed the Fed pricing cuts at the same time. That half is missing here — the Fed just moved the other way.

events.title: Japan's 10-year touches 2.994%
events.detail: Highest since 1996. The 2016 low on the same series was −0.287%.
events.impact: A 328bp round trip on the instrument that funds the world's largest carry trade.

events.title: Emmer: CLARITY only delayed until after the midterms
events.detail: House Majority Whip on the failed Senate cloture vote.
events.impact: Bills die with the Congress. After the midterms this one restarts from introduction, which is a rewrite rather than a resumption.

events.title: Binance opens Capital Connect to qualified individuals
events.detail: Its marketplace for allocating to professional trading strategies, previously businesses only.
events.impact: Listings on any such venue are the strategies still running. The ones that blew up are not on the page.

metrics.label: survivorship
metrics.note: blown-up strategies are not on the page

events.title: Aave plans an RWA hub on Avalanche
events.detail: Institutions post tokenised financial assets as collateral to borrow stablecoins, with Tether's USA₮ named as a dollar liquidity source.
events.impact: Aave V3's entire Avalanche market is $259M, 1.54% of its $16.8B. Avalanche holds $1.39B of stablecoins, 0.46% of all chains. Collateral ports; liquidity does not.

events.title: Zcash holders vote to cut block times 75s → 25s
events.detail: 99.9% in favour, with 97% backing a delay of the Network Sustainability Mechanism to February 2031.
events.impact: Blossom did the same thing in 2019, 150s to 75s with the block reward cut to match. Same playbook, not a new issuance regime.

events.title: US mortgage purchase applications back to 1995 levels
events.impact: Same index, 75 million more Americans than in 1995.

events.title: CLARITY Act cloture fails 46–43
events.detail: Short of the 60 needed, which ends market-structure legislation for this Congress.
events.impact: BTC −3.38%, ETH −4.75%, ETH/BTC −1.42%, US 10-year 4.84% → 5.00%. BTC's beta to a −1.66% NASDAQ day accounts for the whole move; the bill's actual footprint is the 1.42% ETH lost relative to BTC, and (1−3.38%)×(1−1.42%) reconciles to ETH's print exactly.

upcoming.why: 97% of surveyed economists expect 1.25%, a 31-year high. Watch USDJPY and the 10-year together, not either alone.
CLARITY restarts from introduction in the next Congress, so this is the gate on market-structure law.
Subsidy drops to 1.5625 BTC. 82,661 blocks out at the time of writing.
